source: NRCS Air and Water Database (AWDB), wcc.sc.egov.usda.gov/awdbRestApi, SNOTEL snow-water equivalent (WTEQ), daily. Public domain.
panel: Colorado SNOTEL sites installed by 1980 with at least 300 daily readings in every water year 1981-2025 and at least 250 in 2026: the panel of the snowpack-by-decade chart.
median: Each site's median reading on that calendar day across water years 1981-2026; null where the site has fewer than 20 years of readings on that day. 29 February: leap years only.
